name: signin_analyse
description: Read an Entra or Google Workspace login export and surface failures before success, single-factor Entra success, unfamiliar addresses, and impossible-travel hypotheses without treating records of unknown outcome as successes.

path.description: A sign-in log export, CSV or JSON

max_speed_kmh.description: Implied speed above which a pair is flagged (default 900)

limit.description: Maximum events returned inline when out_file is set (default 500); the complete event set is written to out_file

out_file.description: Optional JSONL path for every normalised event; when absent every event is returned inline
